node.title: XR triangular minor-certificate soundness
node.statement: If an admissible specialization of an XR normal-form maximal minor makes the selected square submatrix triangular with every diagonal entry nonzero, then that specialization is a valid nonzero-minor certificate.
node.attack_surface: finite determinant criterion for triangular specialized matrices
node.falsifier: a specialized triangular minor with nonzero diagonal and zero determinant
